assets.prompt:
Use case: faithful 2D game sprite sheet, transparent-background game architecture components.
Image1 is the original approved dungeon STYLE and PROJECTION reference. Study the narrow continuous vertical wall on the RIGHT of its right-hand room. Reproduce that coherent architecture, not a pile of separate pillar faces.
Create a sparse atlas of FOUR SEPARATE COMPLETE SPRITES, all on genuine RGBA transparency. NO backdrop, ambient haze, gradient, floor, scene, UI, label, cast floor shadow or checkerboard pixels. The reference is NOT a background to include.
Canvas landscape, about1536x1024. Four widely spaced columns, one complete vertical sprite centered in each column.
Column1 WEST wall core. Column2 EAST wall core. Column3 west exterior backing ONLY. Column4 east exterior backing ONLY.
CORES: each a narrow straight wall running vertically on screen, approximately136px wide and660px tall. Top THREE QUARTERS (about496px) are ONE continuous overhead stone band with four long contiguous blue stone tops, narrow joints, unified same orientation. The stones touch: NO thick dark south-facing lip under each stone, NO little horizontal filler strips, NO alternation of overhead stones and upright pillar faces, NO duplicated endings. The screen axes are vertical and horizontal, not isometric. Soft painted slate-blue shading, restrained worn edges and dark outlines like reference, not faceted shiny crystals. All ordinary stones are top surfaces seen from the same elevated camera.
The very BOTTOM164px of each core is the SINGLE south-facing upright front facade of the wall's near end, naturally connected under its last cap. Show one small restrained engraved diamond there and one dark low base course. The upper endpoint is just a plain stone cap, NO tall north pillar with a downward face breaking the run. The end facade is drawn ONCE, only at the bottom tip. Total silhouette a narrow straight rectangle with softly chipped edges. West/east cores have exactly matching cap widths, seam heights and total dimensions, with light consistently from upper left. NO lateral exterior/backing row baked into core: that is separate.
BACKINGS columns3/4: each a slender approximately36px wide x660px tall dark rough blue side-edge stone strip, one continuous band, subdued nearly-black blue. No light cap stones or ornament. Same total length as cores. These go OUTSIDE the west/east cores in the engine.
At least50px transparent margin around each sprite and wide transparent separation. Full sprite silhouettes, no crops. Do not assemble a room. Do not show diagrams or alignment lines. Native transparent PNG output.
assets.processing: Byte-for-byte copy. Native generated alpha, no silhouette processing. Whole atlas slots selected in Godot.
